text:
marie (Partnerships): heads up — TerraChip sent final artwork for the marketplace tile and solution brief. uploading here for quick pass. https://files.redwood/terrachip/assets

sam (Design): grabbing now. quick asks: do we have their approved color palette? i remember a gradient they love but marketplace needs flat backgrounds.

marie (Partnerships): they gave both gradient and flat swatches. attached: TC_primary_flat.svg, TC_gradient.svg, TC_logo_lockups.zip. priority: marketplace tile (90KB max), hero lockup for one-pager, and small favicon-like mark.

sam (Design): noted. i'll do 2 tile comps (light bg, dark bg) and an inline lockup for the one-pager. will follow our co-branding rules: 24px clearspace, no resize under 64px for lockup.

ben (Legal): quick reminder — partner sent logo usage guidelines but also a clause about "no implied endorsement" we need in the marketplace listing. marketing should draft the copy and i'll verify.

laura (Prod Marketing): putting that on my plate. draft CTA + blurb coming in 30m. we should also confirm case study callouts allowed: TerraChip wants "reduced inferencing latency by 3x" — need numbers/backup.

kyle (Partner Eng): we have perf numbers from the pilot. i'll attach the telemetry snapshot. also, small note: the tile must not suggest dedicated capacity requirement. marketplace listing should say "compatible with Redwood Dedicated and Hosted".

sam (Design): uploaded comps: https://files.redwood/terrachip/comps/comp-A.png and comp-B.png. used flat teal background per TC_primary_flat.svg. I put the Redwood+TerraChip horizontal lockup on the right.

sam (Design): CSS guidance for marketplace devs (copy to marketplace team):
```
--tile-bg: #0fa3b1; /* TerraChip flat */
--tile-text: #ffffff;
--lockup-min-width: 64px;
--tile-max-size: 90KB;
```

marie (Partnerships): ben — after legal ok, can we get a one-line "co-marketing" disclaimer to append to the listing? e.g., "Joint solution — TerraChip & Redwood Inference. No endorsement implied."

ben (Legal): that wording is ok. prefer: "Joint solution offering by TerraChip and Redwood Inference. No endorsement implied." I'll sign off once I see final copy.

laura (Prod Marketing): draft blurb uploaded: https://docs.redwood/marketing/terrachip-blurb-v1.md — includes the 3x latency claim marked as "pilot result" with link to telemetry. pls review.

kyle (Partner Eng): telemetry link attached: https://telemetry.redwood/terrachip/pilot-2025-11 — contains the test harness config and run artifacts. note that numbers are median p95 over 10k requests.

sam (Design): small asset QA note: SVGs contain embedded fonts — i converted to outlines for the marketplace svg. attached: TC_lockup_marketplace.svg (final). Also exported tile at 88KB.

assetbot: asset size check: TC_lockup_marketplace.svg (88KB) \u2705, tile-light.png (86KB) \u2705, tile-dark.png (91KB) \u26a0\ufe0f (exceeds 90KB)

sam (Design): re-exported tile-dark.png with 8px tighter padding, new size 89KB. uploaded as tile-dark-v2.png.

marie (Partnerships): next steps:
- @ben please final legal signoff on copy (ETA today EOD)
- @sam finalize three asset packages: marketplace (svg/png), one-pager hero (PDF + png), favicon mark (svg/png)
- @laura finalize blurb and add telemetry link
- @kyle confirm any tech constraints for listing (CPU/GPU notes)

ben (Legal): signing off on the copy and the disclaimer. small edit to marketplace listing: remove phrase "guaranteed" from any throughput claims. otherwise ok.

laura (Prod Marketing): updated blurb with Ben's edit. marking ready for marketplace submission.

marie (Partnerships): thanks team — i'll submit to marketplace ops once we have the final zip. please drop final assets here and i'll close the loop with TerraChip. :thumbsup:

sam (Design): uploaded final package: terrachip_marketplace_zip_final.zip

kyle (Partner Eng): confirmed listing notes re: compatible infra; no dedicated-only wording. ready.

marie (Partnerships): great, moving to marketplace ops. tagging @marketplace-ops in a follow-up thread with bundle and approved copy.

laura (Prod Marketing): can we also add a 1-page partner one-pager to the partner portal? i put the PDF in the final zip.

marie (Partnerships): yes — portal add after listing goes live. thanks everyone! :celebrate:
